data.one_liner: High-performance CSV encoder/decoder preserving types and nullability
data.what_it_does: Provides fast encode/decode for CSV with retained type info. Supports strict and flexible formats, string-only, and map encoding.
use_when: Need efficient CSV handling in Dart/Flutter
Require type preservation when serializing data
avoid_when: You need full CSV spec support (comments, varied quoting)
You prefer a higher-level data serialization like JSON
weaknesses: Strict format may break with other CSV tools
Limited to basic types (String, int, double, bool, null)
No support for complex CSV features (comments, custom delimiters)
